utility.name: capa
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Installs Mandiant's capa, which reports what a PE, ELF or .NET executable or a shellcode blob can do (open network connections, encrypt data, persist and so on) by matching its built-in rules, each mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and MBC. Installs the pinned standalone release binary, checked against its SHA-256.
